newsitem.title: FINLAND: KUNTIEN ASUNTOLUOTTO 1996 BALANCE SHEET DOUBLES.
newsitem.headline: KUNTIEN ASUNTOLUOTTO 1996 BALANCE SHEET DOUBLES.

text.p: Finnish municipal housing credit fund Kuntien Asuntoluotto Oy said in a statement on Monday its balance sheet more than doubled last year to 3.02 billion markka at end-December from 1.39 billion a year earlier.

"In 1996, long-term fund raising was 1.42 billion markka, of which only 90.6 million was denominated in foreign currencies," it said, adding it had issued five bonds which were well-received by institutional and private investors.
"The intention is to increase international fund-raising in 1997," it said.

Its stock of credits rose by 1.41 billion markka to 2.41 billion, with 90 percent in loans for new production of leasing property with subsidised interest rates and supplementory guarantees from the government.
The end-year solvency ratio was 171.4 percent, down from 201.5 percent a year earlier, it added.
